decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those shown on the drawings.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Application Form, Location Plan, Design and Access Statement, 1003/TP.20, 1003/TP.21, 1003/TP.22, 1003/TP.23, Received 29 August 2013  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The front and rear amenity space, boundary treatment and cycle parking shown on the approved drawings shall be made available prior to the occupation of the unit and shall be permanently retained thereafter unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority beforehand.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension
